title: Coding agents
sub: The model proposes an edit, your code runs the test, and the model decides whether to try again.

steps.h: The task arrives with the buggy function attached
steps.d:
"Fix sum_evens so it returns the sum of the even
numbers in a list."

steps.h: Your code runs the starting code against the tests and shows the model why it fails
steps.d:
sum_evens([1,2,3,4,5,6]) returned 9, expected 12
(it sums the odd numbers, not the even ones)

steps.h: Your code runs the tests against the proposed edit
steps.d:
sum_evens([1,2,3,4,5,6]) returned 21, expected 12
(this version sums everything, not just the evens)

steps.h: The model tries again, using what the failure said
Your code runs the tests again
The model decides the fix is done and stops
steps.d:
"Fixed: the condition checked for odd numbers
instead of even ones. sum_evens now passes all
four cases."
